manifest.price_rule: bounded alternating price quotes from the frozen strategy plan; accepted quote sets price
manifest.energy_model: One flexible energy pool per household over its delivery window; no power, device or per-hour generation limits.
manifest.utility_formula: surplus_v1: seller utility = sum over its trades of (price - effective floor) x quantity; buyer utility = sum of (maximum price - price) x quantity; no shortfall or missed requirement penalty; welfare = sum of both, so transfers cancel
manifest.admissible_moves: fill within free capacity; replacement of one of the mover's own trades; acceptance by releasing one of the responder's own trades; one provisional trade per seller and buyer pair; the mover gains at least 1 paise; a responder that releases a trade gains at least 1 paise; no coalition or multi trade moves
